description: Continue an existing video with new footage after its end, with the same models as the WaveSpeed /chat page. Turbo models cannot extend. In the prompt, name input media as @image 1, @image 2, @video 1, @audio 1 (counted in the order the lists are given); they are renamed to what the model expects.

duration.description: Seconds of new footage; omit to use the model default.

estimate_only.description: true: only return the price estimate and the request that would run. Nothing is submitted or charged.

last_frame.description: Optional image the continuation should end on.

model.description: Only when the user names a model (seedance-2.5, seedance-2.5-turbo, seedance-2.0, seedance-2.0-turbo, seedance-2.0-fast, seedance-2.0-fast-turbo, seedance-2.0-mini, wan-3.0, wan-3.0-prime, kling-4.0, minimax-h3). Without it the default (seedance-2.5) is used, and another model only when it cannot take the inputs.

resolution.description: Only when the user asks for a resolution, or 480p for a cheaper draft; otherwise omit. MiniMax H3 defaults to 768p (its equivalent of 720p).

wait_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for the result in this call (default 0: return the prediction id right away)

name: extend_video
